<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Liquid Briefing</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fredoka:wght@500;600;700&family=Nunito:wght@400;600;700;800&display=swap">
<style>

/* VOICE: friendly, curious, honest - Dewey reads you the news and checks every fact
   IDEA: a pocket radio with a magnifying glass - the briefing plays, every sentence can be checked
   PICTURE: Dewey the drop with headphones, mood follows the state (happy, checking, talking, oops)
   COLOUR and TYPE: Design System v1 - 60 paper, 30 ink, 10 baby blue; Fredoka display, Nunito UI
   LAYOUT: one calm column, chunky outlined cards with offset shadows, player first */
:root{--paper:#FFFFFF;--ink:#0B0B0F;--ink2:#2A2B31;--mute:#6B6E76;--line:#C9CCD2;--soft:#EEF0F3;--sky:#9ED8FA;--sky2:#C2E6FC;--sky3:#1F6FA3;--dew100:#E1F3FE;--ice:#F0F9FF;--link:#1F6FA3;--link2:#0E3A57;--bad:#B3261E}
*{box-sizing:border-box;min-width:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font:600 16px/1.55 Nunito,system-ui,sans-serif;overflow-x:clip}
a{color:var(--link)}a:hover{color:var(--link2)}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:Fredoka,Nunito,sans-serif;margin:0;line-height:1.08;text-wrap:balance}
h1{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,52px)}h2{font-weight:600;font-size:28px}h3{font-weight:600;font-size:20px}
.wrap{max-width:820px;margin:0 auto;padding:20px clamp(16px,4vw,32px) 48px}
header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:22px}
.logo{font-family:Fredoka,sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:-.01em;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;white-space:nowrap}
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 12px;background:var(--sky)}
.card{border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:26px;box-shadow:0 6px 0 var(--ink);background:var(--paper);padding:22px}
.card+.card,.stack>*+*{margin-top:22px}
.hero{background:var(--sky);display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 280px;gap:18px;align-items:center}
.hero p{margin:10px 0 0;font-size:18px;color:var(--ink2)}
label.lab{display:block;font-weight:800;font-size:15px;margin:0 0 8px}
textarea{width:100%;min-height:118px;font:600 16px/1.5 Nunito,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:18px;padding:14px 16px;resize:vertical;background:var(--ice)}
textarea:focus,button:focus-visible,a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--sky3);outline-offset:3px}
.row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.chip{font:800 15px Nunito,sans-serif;min-height:44px;padding:0 16px;border:2.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:999px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--ink);cursor:pointer}
.chip[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--sky)}
.chip:active,.btn:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:0 0 0 var(--ink)}
.btn{font:800 17px Nunito,sans-serif;min-height:56px;padding:0 28px;border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:18px;background:var(--sky);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 5px 0 var(--ink);cursor:pointer}
.btn.dark{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 5px 0 var(--ink2)}.btn.white{background:#fff}
.btn[disabled]{border-color:var(--line);background:var(--soft);color:var(--mute);box-shadow:0 5px 0 var(--line);cursor:wait}
.hint{font-size:14px;color:var(--mute);margin:8px 0 0}
.field+.field{margin-top:20px}
.seg{display:inline-flex;border:2.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--ink)}
.seg button{font:800 15px Nunito,sans-serif;min-height:44px;padding:0 16px;border:0;border-left:2.5px solid var(--ink);background:#fff;cursor:pointer;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.seg button:first-child{border-left:0}.seg button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--sky)}
.or{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:var(--mute);font-weight:800;font-size:13px;margin:18px 0 12px}.or::before,.or::after{content:"";flex:1;border-top:2px dashed var(--line)}
/* working */
.work{text-align:center;background:var(--ice)}
.work .dewey{margin:0 auto}
.steps{list-style:none;margin:18px auto 0;padding:0;max-width:440px;text-align:left}
.steps li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:9px 0;font-weight:700;color:var(--mute)}
.steps li .dot{width:26px;height:26px;flex:none;border:2.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:14px;background:#fff}
.steps li.on{color:var(--ink)}.steps li.on .dot{border-color:var(--ink);background:var(--sky)}
.steps li.done{color:var(--ink2)}.steps li.done .dot{border-color:var(--ink);background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.timer{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink2)}
/* player */
.player{background:var(--sky);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;text-align:center}
.bar{position:relative;width:100%;height:20px;border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:999px;background:var(--soft);overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;margin-top:10px;isolation:isolate;-webkit-mask-image:-webkit-radial-gradient(white,black);transform:translateZ(0)}
.bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:var(--ink);border-radius:0;transition:width .25s linear}
.times{width:100%;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.ctrls{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:22px;margin-top:6px}
.round{width:54px;height:54px;border:2.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:999px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--ink);display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;padding:0}
.round.big{width:78px;height:78px;border-width:3px;background:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 5px 0 var(--ink2)}
.now{background:#fff}
.now .k{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px}
.now p{margin:0;font-weight:700;font-size:18px;line-height:1.45}
.src{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;text-underline-offset:3px;min-height:40px}
.tx{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.tx li{padding:12px 14px;border-radius:16px;border:2.5px solid transparent;cursor:pointer}
.tx li+li{margin-top:4px}
.tx li.cur{border-color:var(--ink);background:var(--ice)}
.tx .tag{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--mute);text-transform:none}
.tx p{margin:2px 0 0;font-weight:700}
details{border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--ink);background:#fff;padding:0 18px}
details+details{margin-top:14px}
summary{cursor:pointer;font-family:Fredoka,sans-serif;font-weight:600;font-size:19px;min-height:56px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;list-style:none}
summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}summary::after{content:"+";margin-left:auto;font-size:24px}details[open] summary::after{content:"–"}
details>div{padding:0 0 18px}
.kv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,170px) minmax(0,1fr);gap:6px 14px;margin:0}
.kv dt{color:var(--mute);font-weight:800;font-size:14px}.kv dd{margin:0;font-weight:700}
ul.why{margin:6px 0 0;padding-left:20px}ul.why li{margin:3px 0}
.story{border:2.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:16px;padding:12px 14px;margin-top:10px;background:var(--ice)}
.story.cut{background:#fff;border-style:dashed}
.score{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--mute);font-size:14px}
.removed{color:var(--bad)}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}td{padding:8px 4px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--soft);vertical-align:top}td:last-child{text-align:right;font-weight:800}
.err{background:#fff;text-align:center}
.foot{margin-top:28px;text-align:center;color:var(--mute);font-size:14px}
.hidden{display:none!important}
.dewey{display:block}
@keyframes bob{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-8px)}}
.bob{animation:bob 1.8s ease-in-out infinite}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.bob{animation:none}.bar i{transition:none}html{scroll-behavior:auto}}
@media (max-width:600px){header .pill{display:none}.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;text-align:center}.herocrew{margin:0 auto}.kv{grid-template-columns:1fr}.card{padding:18px}.seg button{padding:0 11px}}

/* v0.5: account, onboarding wizard, generate page */
input.txt{width:100%;font:700 18px Nunito,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:18px;padding:14px 16px;background:var(--ice);min-height:56px}
input.txt:focus{outline:3px solid var(--sky3);outline-offset:3px}
.tabs{display:inline-flex;border:2.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--ink);margin-bottom:18px}
.tabs button{font:800 15px Nunito,sans-serif;min-height:44px;padding:0 20px;border:0;background:#fff;cursor:pointer}
.tabs button+button{border-left:2.5px solid var(--ink)}.tabs button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--sky)}
.authgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 180px;gap:18px;align-items:center}
.msg{font-weight:800;font-size:14px;margin:10px 0 0;color:var(--bad)}.msg.ok{color:var(--ink)}
.dots{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin:0 0 16px}
.dots i{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:999px;border:2.5px solid var(--ink);background:#fff}.dots i.on{background:var(--ink)}
.ask{font-family:Fredoka,sans-serif;font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(24px,3.4vw,32px);margin:6px 0 4px;line-height:1.15}
.opts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:16px}
.opt{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:2px;text-align:left;font:800 17px Nunito,sans-serif;padding:14px 16px;min-height:64px;border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:18px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--ink);cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink)}
.opt small{font-weight:600;font-size:14px;color:var(--mute)}
.opt[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--sky)}.opt[aria-pressed=true] small{color:var(--ink2)}
.opt:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--ink)}
.navrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-top:24px}
.sub{font-family:Fredoka,sans-serif;font-weight:600;font-size:18px;margin:20px 0 0}
.hello{background:var(--sky);display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px minmax(0,1fr);gap:16px;align-items:center}
.hello p{margin:4px 0 0;color:var(--ink2)}
.linkbtn{background:none;border:0;padding:0;font:800 14px Nunito,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;cursor:pointer;min-height:32px}
.switches{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:12px}
.sw{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;text-align:left;padding:12px 14px;border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:18px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--ink);cursor:pointer;font:inherit;color:var(--ink);min-height:72px}
.sw b{display:block;font-size:16px}.sw small{display:block;font-size:13px;color:var(--mute);font-weight:600}
.sw .tg{flex:none;width:44px;height:26px;border:2.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:999px;background:var(--soft);position:relative}
.sw .tg::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:17px;height:17px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--ink);transition:left .15s}
.sw[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--ice)}.sw[aria-pressed=true] .tg{background:var(--ink)}.sw[aria-pressed=true] .tg::after{left:20px}
.voice{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:10px}
.topics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:12px}
.tp{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;text-align:left;padding:14px;border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:18px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--ink);cursor:pointer;font:inherit;color:var(--ink);min-height:120px}
.tp .pill{align-self:flex-start;background:#fff;font-size:12px}
.tp b{font-size:15px;line-height:1.35}
.tp small{color:var(--mute);font-size:13px;font-weight:700;margin-top:auto}
.tp[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--sky)}.tp[aria-pressed=true] .pill{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.who{font-size:14px;color:var(--mute);margin:8px 0 0}
@media (max-width:600px){.authgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.authgrid>div:last-child{display:none}.hello{grid-template-columns:72px minmax(0,1fr)}.opts{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.sw .tg::after{transition:none}}
/* v1.0 Deweys Crew: picker, stage, player */
.genhead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.crows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.crow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:62px minmax(0,1fr) 28px;gap:12px;align-items:center;text-align:left;width:100%;padding:8px 10px;border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:20px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--ink);cursor:pointer;font:inherit;color:inherit}
.crow[aria-checked=true]{background:var(--ice)}
.crow:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--ink)}
.ctile{position:relative;width:62px;height:62px;border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;display:block}
.ctile lb-crew{position:absolute;width:72px;left:-8px;top:-1px;--lb-bubble-size:0px}
.cnm{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.cnm b{font:700 21px Fredoka,Nunito,sans-serif}
.ctag{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;padding:2px 9px;border:2.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:999px;background:#fff;white-space:nowrap}
.cq{display:block;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.3;margin-top:2px}
.ctick{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ink);display:grid;place-items:center;opacity:0}
.crow[aria-checked=true] .ctick{opacity:1}
.begin{border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:20px;padding:12px 14px;margin-top:14px}
.begin .brow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.begin p{margin:8px 0 0;font-size:17px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.4}
.begin p.score{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;margin-top:6px}
.cstage{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;padding:46px 12px 4px;min-height:280px;border-bottom:3px solid var(--ink);background:var(--ice);transition:background .3s}
.cstage lb-crew{width:min(70%,320px);--lb-bubble-size:16px}
.phase{position:absolute;top:14px;left:14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;padding:4px 12px;border:2.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:999px;background:#fff}
.work .steps{margin-top:14px}
.tipcard{background:var(--ice)}
.onbcrew .crows{margin-top:16px}
@media (max-width:600px){.cstage{min-height:220px}}


/* v1.1 Design System v1 "Sweet Ink" + crew screens: header, 3D host carousel, host card, player */
header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.profbtn{width:44px;height:44px;border:2.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:999px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--ink);display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0;cursor:pointer}
.profbtn:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:0 0 0 var(--ink)}
.pickhead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.pickhead h1{font-size:clamp(30px,4.6vw,44px);line-height:1.05}
.carousel{position:relative;perspective:900px;perspective-origin:50% 35%;touch-action:pan-y;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;overflow:hidden;margin-top:14px;outline:none;background:var(--sky);border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:32px;--lb-shade:#7CC6F2}
.carousel:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--sky3);outline-offset:3px}
.car-track{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-style:preserve-3d}
.car-item{position:absolute;left:50%;top:52px;width:var(--cw,224px);margin-left:calc(var(--cw,224px) / -2);transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.85,.25,1),opacity .5s;cursor:pointer;will-change:transform}
.carousel.dragging .car-item{transition:none}
.car-float{animation:lbdrift 5.6s ease-in-out infinite}
.car-item.on .car-float{animation:lbfloat 3.6s ease-in-out infinite}
.car-float lb-crew{display:block;width:100%;--lb-bubble-size:15px}
@keyframes lbdrift{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-4px)}}
@keyframes lbfloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(4px)}50%{transform:translateY(-16px)}}
.car-label{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:16px;z-index:120;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:8px;pointer-events:none}
.car-label b{font:700 26px/1 Fredoka,sans-serif}
.car-nav{position:absolute;top:calc(50% - 30px);z-index:30;width:48px;height:48px;border:2.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:999px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--ink);display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;padding:0}
.car-nav:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--ink)}
.car-nav.prev{left:14px}.car-nav.next{right:14px}
.car-dots{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:8px;margin-top:4px}
.car-dots button{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:999px;border:2.5px solid var(--ink);background:#fff;padding:0;cursor:pointer}
.car-dots button[aria-current=true]{background:var(--ink);width:28px}
.hostcard{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.hc-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hc-top .pill{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}
.hc-q{font:600 clamp(22px,3vw,28px)/1.15 Fredoka,sans-serif;margin:0}
.hc-for{margin:0;color:var(--mute);font-weight:700;font-size:14px}
.hc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px}
.hc-lab{font-weight:800;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute);margin:0 0 6px}
.hc-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.hc-chips span{font-weight:800;font-size:13px;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;background:var(--dew100)}
.hc-chips.skip span{background:#fff;border-color:var(--line);color:var(--mute);text-decoration:line-through}
.hc-flow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.hc-flow span{font-weight:800;font-size:13px;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:10px;padding:4px 10px;background:#fff}
.hc-flow i{font-style:normal;font-weight:800}
.hc-words{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:10px}
.hc-words p{margin:0;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:14px;padding:8px 12px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.4}
.hc-words p.never{border-color:var(--line);color:var(--mute)}
.hc-open{margin:0;border:2.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:18px;padding:12px 14px;background:var(--ice);font-weight:700;font-size:17px;line-height:1.4}
.player{position:relative;background:var(--sky);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;text-align:center;padding:42px 18px 20px}
.player.dark{color:#fff}.player.dark .phase{color:var(--ink)}
.player h1{font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,36px);line-height:1.1}
.pstage{width:min(62%,260px)}
.pstage lb-crew{width:100%;--lb-bubble-size:15px}
.player .phase{position:absolute;top:14px;left:14px}
.pctl{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.pctl .bar i{background:var(--accent,var(--sky));box-shadow:inset -3px 0 0 var(--ink)}
@media (max-width:600px){.hc-grid,.hc-words{grid-template-columns:1fr}.car-nav{display:none}.carousel{margin:12px 0 0;border-radius:26px}.car-dots button{width:16px;height:16px}.car-dots button[aria-current=true]{width:32px}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.car-item{transition:none}.car-float,.car-item.on .car-float{animation:none}}

/* hero: Dewey with two of his crew, all floating */
.herocrew{position:relative;width:290px;height:250px;--lb-shade:#7CC6F2}
.hcr{position:absolute}
.hcr lb-crew,.hcr lb-dewey{display:block;width:100%;--lb-bubble-size:13px}
.hcr.back{width:120px;left:0;top:30px;z-index:1}
.hcr.mid{width:172px;left:58px;top:8px;z-index:2}
.hcr.front{width:148px;right:-12px;top:88px;z-index:3}
.hcr.back .hfl{animation:lbdrift 5.2s ease-in-out infinite -1.3s}
.hcr.mid .hfl{animation:lbfloat 3.8s ease-in-out infinite}
.hcr.front .hfl{animation:lbfloat 4.6s ease-in-out infinite -2.1s}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.hcr .hfl{animation:none}}

/* v1.2 clean host intro + folded transcript */
.hostcard{gap:14px;text-align:center;align-items:center;padding:20px 22px}

## Workflow C - Liquid Briefing website
**Publish this workflow AND Workflow B** (toggle top right), then open the production URL of *Website*: `https://<your-n8n>/webhook/lb-app`.
- `lb-app` serves the page (Design System v1, Dewey).
- The page calls `lb-start` (Workflow B: starts a briefing job, returns job_id), then polls `lb-status` and plays `lb-audio`.
- Jobs live in Data Tables `lb_jobs` / `lb_audio` (written by Workflow B).
To change the page: edit `web/app.html`, run `node build_workflow_c.js`, re-import.
